aboutText: At Lygon St Nursery & Landscapes, we've been crafting beautiful gardens in Brunswick East for years. Our team starts with a personal on-site consultation to understand your vision, site specifics, and budget. Whether you need a complete landscape overhaul or subtle enhancements, we tailor every project to your needs. We're passionate about bringing green spaces to life in your local area.
servicesText: We offer a full range of landscaping services to Brunswick East residents, from initial design concepts to final construction and planting. Our expertise ensures your outdoor space is both functional and beautiful, tailored to the unique character of your property.
